positions.name: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd.
positions.catalyst: After Tuesday's close ZIM raised FY26 guidance: Adj. EBITDA $2.7-3.0B (was $2.0-2.4B, +30% at midpoint) and Adj. EBIT $1.4-1.7B (was $0.7-1.1B, +72%) on strong freight rates/demand.
positions.driver: Muted +4.6% pre-market reaction to a very large raise; $3.5B market cap vs $1.4-1.7B guided EBIT and P/B ~0.9; sits just under its $30.96 52-week high, so a breakout opens price discovery. Stop sits under Monday/Tuesday's ~$28.90 base.
positions.risks: Shipping names often fade guidance raises on peak-cycle fears (ZIM fell after its Q2 beat); freight rates tied to Gulf/Iran-war disruption can reverse on de-escalation; Israel geopolitical risk; risk-off tape (futures -0.1 to -0.4%, 10Y 5.32%) ahead of 2pm ET FOMC minutes; wide pre-market spread.
